name: cachewraith-skills
description: A working toolkit of five skills for day-to-day engineering in Claude Code: an OWASP Top Ten security audit that names the category ID for every finding, a performance audit that reports evidence rather than vibes, a test skill that finds and uses the project's own runner, a branch-and-commit helper with a fixed naming convention and no model attribution in the message, an API documentation generator that investigates real endpoints and publishes frontend-ready docs as an Artifact, and a release helper that bumps the version everywhere it lives in any ecosystem, then tags and pushes it.
